summary: Full validation of six pages in the sample-marketing Power BI report: Leads, Inquiries and Reinquiries, Contract Velocity, Meta Daily, Executive Summary P&L, and Daily Leads. Each page received a baseline/change/reset interaction cycle with DAX oracles. Model lint flagged 58 findings across 7 categories. Statistical and DAX probes identified three failed invariants: 534 contracts with non-positive contract_value, 33 spend rows outside campaign windows, and 6,074 inquiry date keys cut at UTC instead of Toronto time. The monthly combo on Inquiries does not react to the date slicer (confirmed NoFilter interaction override).

scope.period: Baseline July 1-13 2026; extended ranges as noted per component.
scope.timezone: America/Toronto (reporting); submit_date_key is UTC-based (confirmed by BQ q7_tz: 6,074 Toronto mismatches).
scope.import_watermark: Inquiries through 2026-09-03; spend/Meta through 2026-09-04; contracts include scheduled future starts through 2026-09-28.
scope.population: All franchises, channels, provinces, campuses unless page has a saved selection (Contract Velocity: 3 channels; P&L and Daily Leads: 6 channels).
scope.data_completeness: BQ q1_ranges confirms fact_program_inquiry 69,289 rows (2026-01-01 to 2026-09-03), fact_meta_leads_daily 1,791 rows, fact_contract 24,004 rows, fact_ad_spend_allocated_daily 26,842 rows. dim_date covers all of 2026.

findings.title: Monthly combo chart ignores the date slicer
findings.explanation: The page definition declares a NoFilter interaction from the date slicer (1b965d3ef84d66e7da2b) to the monthly combo (a07546fd67a2c7b9b668). Visual text confirmed identical months for Jul 1-13 and Jul 1-7 ranges. Users selecting a date range may expect the monthly chart to update.
findings.impact: The monthly combo always shows all-time data regardless of the date slicer, which may mislead users who expect it to respect their date selection.

findings.title: Inquiry date keys are UTC-based, not Toronto time
findings.explanation: BQ q7_tz shows 0 UTC mismatches but 6,074 Toronto mismatches (8.8% of 69,289 rows). submit_date_key = DATE(submit_at) in UTC, not DATE(submit_at, America/Toronto). The DAX probe event-day-utc passed (0 mismatches) while event-day-toronto failed. Context.md states reporting timezone is America/Toronto.
findings.impact: Late-night inquiries in Eastern time are attributed to the wrong calendar day. Daily counts near midnight differ from what a Toronto-based analyst expects. This affects all daily charts and the is_current_mtd page filter.

limitations: No approved business definitions; all definitions derived from DAX implementation.
Card values showing abbreviated amounts ($240K, $840K) could not be parsed as numbers; the P&L toggle test observed text only.
The Daily Leads page has no date range slicer; the requested Jul 1-31 / Aug 1-31 cycle was not achievable through the UI.

Contract Velocity and P&L pages have saved channel slicer selections that limit the visible population; these were identified by matching oracle values but not independently confirmed through the slicer dropdown.
Report not refreshed or edited; all observations reflect the imported snapshot as of the watermark dates.
RLS/OLS not tested; the model has 0 roles. Desktop admin access does not establish user-level visibility.
Lint findings are inconclusive review leads, not verdicts; each needs analyst context.
Statistical probes that returned review flags need business explanation before sign-off.
BigQuery discovery queries ran at query time, not at import time; row counts may differ from the imported model if the warehouse was updated since the last import.
